## Where

- Repository:
- Commit (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`):
- Branch, if not the default:

## What happens

A short description of the behaviour, and what you expected instead.

## How to reproduce

The commands you ran, in order. A shell transcript is worth more than prose.

```shell

```

## Environment

Host OS and architecture, plus the versions of whichever tools are involved — the
compiler or toolchain, the runtime, and anything the repository's README told you to
install.

## Output

Build log, console output, or whatever the failure printed, as text in a code fence
rather than a screenshot — it needs to be searchable.

```text

```

## Anything you already tried

Workarounds, related issues upstream, or a diagnosis if you have one. Optional.
